templates.title: Rapid tram: Sosnowiec–Siemianowice–Katowice
templates.confidence: High for the named anchor sequence; schematic for station placement and alignment
templates.description: The 2018 GZM concept lists a rapid-tram connection from Sosnowiec Osiedle Zagórze via Sosnowiec Centrum, Będzin Koszelew and a Siemianowice Śląskie monorail interchange to Katowice Metropolia. The concept gives candidate anchor names, not surveyed stop sites or street-level geometry. The rapid-tram network is a recommendation, not an approved build project.

templates.title: Metropolitan rail: Katowice–Mysłowice
templates.status: historical service concept over existing railway
templates.confidence: High for the named corridor; station sequence reflects current existing rail stops
templates.description: The 2018 concept classifies Katowice–Mysłowice as a metropolitan basic line using UIC railway. This is a proposed service role on an existing rail corridor, not a proposal for a new track alignment. The editable station chain follows current passenger stations on that corridor.
